amendment.sourceLocator: 2024 AIF, printed p. 9 / PDF page 10, Rare Earth Magnet Plant in Europe
amendment.interpretation: Neo 2024 AIF retrospectively reports revision in November 2024; 2025 Estonian Ministry of Finance audit independently identifies the administrative amendment decision as no. 11-2/24/4882 dated November 28, 2024. The audit does not attach the actual grant-change decision, its financial ceiling nor service/effective-date clause; never promote its decision date as certain money-effective date without checking that instrument.

administrativeDecision.locator: Official Ministry of Finance JTF-2/2025 audit PDF page 3, section 1.1

reportedAmounts.asReported: approximately €14.7 million at 23.3% for eligible project costs €63.3 million
€14,790,898.00 awarded under 'Magnetitehas Narva', eligible project cost €63,327,184.00

reconciliation.precisionIssue: A 23.3% rate of €63.3M gives €14.7489M before rounding; inputs themselves are rounded, so this calculation cannot establish an exact contract ceiling or prove a new amendment.
requiredBeforePromotion: Obtain decision 11-2/24/4882 dated 2024-11-28 and decision 11-2/25/4023 dated 2025-09-16 (both cited in official Ministry JTF-2/2025 audit), read exact award-ceiling terms and their legal effective-upon-service dates; retain unknowns if not proven.
Source-backed explanation whether €14.7M and €14.8M are different report rounding/estimating of one amended award versus successive legally distinct award ceilings.
Separate legal award face value from reimbursement received, project cost, EDC financing and grant rate.
Independent human approval of proposed historical version windows, with the latest version exactly matching the canonical current amount.

Current grant-beneficiary identity is corrected to NPM Narva OÜ, but the historical 2022 NPM Silmet award and 2023 change decision still require the original instrument to establish recipient-effective date and legal continuity before a date-sliced recipient series.

Audit also identifies original decision 11-2/22/3107 and 2023 grantee-transfer decision 11-2/23/3085; trace original NPM Silmet award through the 95%-budget transfer to NPM Narva before naming recipient on earlier historical versions.

officialProjectRegister.note: EIS grant register explicitly identifies the legal current recipient NPM Narva OÜ, which is now separately registered and used in the current canonical finance row (F4-B4). ministryAudit.note: Auditors identify procedural documentation/assessment issues, not withdrawal of the grant, and find project spending/use substantially compliant. The 2024 decision changed project budget; monetary support/percentage per version requires original administrative amendment. 2025 follow-on amendment must also be inspected before claiming amount series complete.

currentRecipientResolution.note: Corrects CURRENT Estonian grant beneficiary only; Neo Performance Materials Inc. stays group sponsor/issuer context, NPM Silmet OÜ original 2022 grantee; no backdated recipient series or direct-parent assertion is invented.
